name: OpenLoong
summary:
OpenLoong is an open-source humanoid robotics project incubated by the OpenAtom Foundation and operated by Humanoid Robot (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. It aims to make the process of creating and developing humanoid robots more accessible through shared hardware, software and community resources.

The project's portfolio includes the Qinglong reference humanoid and Qinglong Mini, with associated datasets and development materials. These resources support work on robot control, learning and application development. OpenLoong's role is therefore both a physical robot platform and a collaborative development effort, enabling research teams and industry participants to build on a common starting point.
